messages:
Maria Gomez: Hey team — heads up I have a passport appointment Sunday 9:15–12:30 PT and I'll be offline. Can someone cover the 09:00–13:00 oncall window? I can trade for another weekend later.
Chris Patel: I can take 09:00–11:00 if that helps. :+1:
Lee Zhang: I can pick up 11:00–13:00. Any prewarm/runbook notes I should follow? Last deploy made EFS a bit slow on cold starts.
Samir Khan: quick ask: please enable quiet-mode for the model spool during the window to reduce noisy retries — runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-basic
OncallBot: schedule-check — Maria Gomez (primary) 09:00-13:00; Chris Patel (tentative 09:00-11:00); Lee Zhang (tentative 11:00-13:00). No overlapping conflicts detected.
Maria Gomez: Thanks folks — leaving handoff below. I'll be offline for the appointment and won't have cell. If anything is urgent DM me before 08:30.
Maria Gomez: Handoff notes:
- Primary watch: hostpool-A latency and model-queue depth alerts
- Known risk: cold EFS mounts can spike p95 after idle windows
- Quick checklist:
  * prewarm EFS cache + KV cache before 09:00
  * verify canary traffic route is healthy (canary/hostpool-A)
  * if p95 > 400ms or queue > 1000 escalate
- Commands I usually run:
```
./scripts/cache-warm --prefix "session" --target shard-3
curl -X POST https://ops.internal/quiet-mode/enable -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"window":"09:00-13:00"}'
routes set --service inference --fallback model-small
```
- Links: dashboard: https://observability.internal/hostpool-A, runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-basic
Chris Patel: Got it. I'll run prewarm at 08:45 and watch the canary, will post when done.
Lee Zhang: I'll take the 11:00 handover and do a quick latency sweep at 11:05. If routes need flipping I'll run: `routes set --fallback model-small` and leave a note here. OK?
Samir Khan: OK from me. If a pager fires, escalate to @oncall-lead (Samir Khan) and paste the thread + relevant logs.
OncallBot: Reminder scheduled prewarm for 08:45 set by Chris Patel.
Chris Patel: prewarm started 08:45. cache-warm script returned: "warm complete". cache hit rate at 08:50 = 92% :white_check_mark:
Lee Zhang: took handoff at 11:04. quick checks: latency p95 = 180ms, queue length = 320. continuing to monitor.
Samir Khan: noted. leaving monitoring on the thread — ping here if anything changes.
Maria Gomez: Thank you all. I owe someone July 17 swap for PTO if anyone wants it. Appreciate the cover :heart:
